svg.title: One pipeline run, several feeds
svg.desc: One scheduled run reads a configuration of approved feeds. For each feed it generates a fresh signature from the same registered credentials, makes that feed's own API request, receives download links, reads the files and writes the records into that feed's own Bronze table.
svg.text: one feed per request, not one feed per run
Proposed design. Table names are illustrative. Endpoint paths are from my notes on Walmart's endpoint list, not checked against the API reference.

g.text: 1. One schedule, one run, a list of feeds
The run reads which approved feeds to request and which Bronze table receives each feed's data.
2. The same credentials sign each call
No new Consumer ID or key pair is needed for another feed, if the identity has access to both. Each request still gets its own fresh signature.
3. Two separate requests, each with its own authentication
Store Sales and Omni Sales have separate endpoints. Each request carries the Consumer ID, key version, signature and timestamp.
4. Each feed lands in its own Bronze table
The code retrieves each feed's files and routes its records to the matching Bronze table.
One schedule, one run, several authenticated requests, several Bronze tables
Seeing two tables updated by one job
That does not mean there was only one API request. There was one request per configured feed.
